# Independent private-input fixtures

Unmodified JSON copied from the CFRG author-maintained pseudonym draft repository,
commit `fcbba956b7f8ed573c7589192f10decd3d2b8fc4` on 2026-10-13. File SHA-256 values
and original paths are in `provenance.json`. These inputs were not recovered from
expected output or generated by Hum. Tests compare the commitment/signature/proof
outputs to published draft -03 before using the complete private inputs.

Source: https://github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-bbs-pseudonyms/tree/fcbba956b7f8ed573c7589192f10decd3d2b8fc4/fixtures/fixture_data/bls12-381-sha-256

The upstream CONTRIBUTING.md declares these IETF contributions subject to BCP78,
BCP79 and IETF Trust Legal Provisions, including Simplified BSD for code
components. The existing adjacent `LICENSE-CODE-COMPONENTS.txt` applies to
extracted code-component fixtures; upstream CONTRIBUTING.md is retained here.
Only the SHA-256 N=1 fixtures represented in the published -03 draft are selected;
this does not adopt upstream multi-secret behavior or a later draft.
